# Purrth Vader

A user-installable AI companion for Discord. This template demonstrates user-installable app features.

<Cards>
  <Card href="/docs/ai" title="@robojs/ai" description="AI plugin for Robo.js." />
  <Card href="/docs/discord-bots" title="Documentation" description="Getting started with Robo.js" />
</Cards>

## Getting Started

Create a project with this template:

```package-install
npx create-robo <project-name> --template discord-bots/purrth-vader-ts
```

Then navigate into your project directory:

```bash
cd <project-name>
```

Configure your API keys in `.env`:

```bash
OPENAI_API_KEY=your-api-key
```

Run development mode:

```bash
npm run dev
```

## Features

- User-installable Discord app
- AI-powered conversations
- Personal assistant functionality
- Works in DMs and servers

## Hosting

```bash
npm run deploy
```
